source: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: docs re-fetched 2026-08-29 by the orchestrator (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md); producer recorded the delivered set. Amendment 13 R281 bounded recapture at the installed 2.1.251 CLI following the M0-T092 precedent (2.1.247->2.1.248). Unlike that identical-set re-point, the 2.1.251 documented event set is a REAL +2 drift versus the 2.1.248 catalog: PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch were added (33 events total, was 31); no events removed.

common_input_fields.hook_event_name: name of the event that fired (measured-live on 2.1.246/2.1.247 in statusline_live_2026-08-27_2_1_247_r162_discharge.json hook_userpromptsubmit_* payloads)
common_input_fields.transcript_path: path to conversation JSON (masked [HOME] in every committed artifact)
common_input_fields.cwd: working directory when the hook fired
common_input_fields.permission_mode: default | plan | acceptEdits | auto | dontAsk | bypassPermissions
common_input_fields.prompt_id: UUID of the user prompt; absent until first user input; requires >= 2.1.196
common_input_fields.effort: object with level field; present for tool-use context events when the model supports effort
common_input_fields.agent_id: subagent identifier (only when running with --agent or inside a subagent)
common_input_fields.agent_type: agent name (only when running with --agent or inside a subagent)
common_input_fields.field_note: Only the documented common input fields are recorded. No PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch-specific payload fields are invented here: the orchestrator delivered the 2.1.251 event NAME set from the re-fetched docs, and per-event field-level docs for the two added events were not part of the delivered set. Per-event measured-live payload capture stays the owner-gated C1 canary (R192/R197).

drift_vs_2_1_220.baseline: telemetry_hooks.KNOWN_HOOK_EVENTS (official docs at 2.1.220, fetched 2026-08-25; identical name-for-name to the 2.1.247 and 2.1.248 catalogs at 31 events)
drift_vs_2_1_220.note: REAL +2 event-set drift at 2.1.251: PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch were added to the 31-event 2.1.220/2.1.247/2.1.248 baseline (33 events total); no events were removed. This is NOT the identical-set situation of the 2.1.247->2.1.248 re-point. The deterministic drift test asserts this recorded reconciliation matches catalog_drift() output (added=[PostModelSwitch, PreModelSwitch], removed=[], sorted); the live tooth goes RED if the installed version moves past this fixture's claude_version (2.1.251) without a re-capture. KNOWN_HOOK_EVENTS is deliberately NOT widened here: the drift is recorded as a reconciled FACT the test bites on, exactly as R173 'unknown and version-drift handling' requires, and telemetry_hooks.py is outside this task's scope.

upgrade_path: per-event measured-live payload capture (including the two added model-switch events) is the owner-gated C1 canary (R192/R197 exact-command approval); this record is documentation-confidence until then, exactly as the 2.1.220/2.1.248 catalogs were. The 2_1_247 and 2_1_248 catalogs stay committed as append-only history.
